svg.title: The baseline model tracks weather it never saw; what it leaves is each region's own pre-2022 trend

cc:Work.dc:title: The baseline model tracks weather it never saw; what it leaves is each region's own pre-2022 trend
cc:Work.dc:description: Four regions: model vs actual over a held-out July week, and baseline residuals within ±6% with small trends.
